name: dsh-jiaofei-ledger
description: 在会话标题下的页签行（「会话文件」左侧）加一个「任务」入口：下拉自动列出所有启用的定时任务，点一条先弹确认，确认后把该任务的提醒原文投进当前会话立即执行；另有一条内置兜底项「未缴费清单」。只读，不改台账文件。 | Adds a Tasks entry to the session tab row (left of Session files): the menu lists every active scheduled task, asks for confirmation, then posts that task's own reminder text into the current session; one built-in fallback entry for the unpaid-fee list.
